macros.name: alt
macros.doc: Only one ⟨overlay specification⟩ may be given. The default text is shown on the specified slides, otherwise the alternative text.

macros.name: animate
macros.doc: The slides specified by ⟨overlay specification⟩ will be shown as quickly as possible.

macros.name: beamerdefaultoverlayspecification
macros.doc: Locally sets the default overlay specification to the given value.

macros.name: only
macros.doc: If either ⟨overlay specification⟩ is present (though only one may be present), the ⟨text⟩ is inserted only into the specified slides.

macros.name: opaqueness
macros.doc: The ⟨overlay specification⟩ specifies on which slides covered text should have which ⟨percentage of opaqueness⟩.

macros.name: pause
macros.doc: This command causes the text following it to be shown only from the next slide on, or, if the optional ⟨number⟩ is given, from the slide with the number ⟨number⟩.

macros.name: pause
macros.doc: This command causes the text following it to be shown only from the next slide on, or, if the optional ⟨number⟩ is given, from the slide with the number ⟨number⟩.

macros.name: setbeamercovered
macros.doc: This command allows you to specify in a quite general way how a covered item should be rendered.

arg.snippet: temporal<${1:overlay specification}>{${2:before slide text}}{${3:default text}}{${4:after slide text}}

macros.name: textbf
macros.doc: For the command \textbf, the overlay specification causes the text to be set in boldface only on the specified slides.

macros.name: uncover
macros.doc: If the ⟨overlay specification⟩ is present, the ⟨text⟩ is shown (“uncovered”) only on the specified slides.

macros.name: visible
macros.doc: This command does almost the same as \uncover. The only difference is that if the text is not shown, it is never shown in a transparent way, but rather it is not shown at all.

envs.name: altenv

arg.snippet: <${1:overlay specification}>{${2:begin text}}{${3:end text}}{${4:alternate begin text}}{${5:alternate end text}}

envs.doc: Only one ⟨overlay specification⟩ may be given. On the specified slides, ⟨begin text⟩ will be inserted at the beginning of the environment and ⟨end text⟩ will be inserted at the end.

envs.name: onlyenv
envs.doc: If the ⟨overlay specification⟩ is given, the contents of the environment is inserted into the text only on the specified slides.

envs.name: overlayarea
envs.doc: Everything within the environment will be placed in a rectangular area of the specified size.
